description: Look up a zkSync Era transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in ETH, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use zksync_receipt, for emitted events zksync_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xc0003ffe194dfc1be40e1b1e6dfdf7609f89cc1393ff774dcd657f226558c5b3. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: zksync_tx
title: zkSync Era transaction
